_about: Approved humor lines (Hoover_Humor_Card_Review_V1_19OCT26, approved by Dustin 19 OCT). Lull cards: same shape as hoover_lore.json cards, hook 'lull', sessions they may air in. Each is read once a night by the analyst, within v3.humor caps (practice 8, quali 2, race 3), never near a human incident. Edit, strike or add here; a lore rebuild never touches this file. Event-triggered pairs live in hoover_words_v4.json as `then` reactions with register humor.

cards.line: Seven drivers, ten teams, and every one of them is convinced the other six are the problem.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: For the record, the AI drivers were not interviewed. They declined to comment, in the sense that they cannot.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Thirty minutes of practice. Thirty minutes to find out which setup change was a mistake.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: This is a charity race. The charities, we are told, would prefer the cars came back in one piece.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Damage is on tonight. Last time it was off, and some of these drivers may need reminding.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: One mandatory pit stop tonight. Several drivers have confirmed they know where the pit lane is.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Qualifying is eighteen minutes. That is roughly one good lap and seventeen minutes of excuses.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: The commentary tonight is artificial. The crashes, we are assured, will be genuine.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Yas Marina at night. The lights are on. Whether anyone is home, we find out shortly.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Every driver chose his own charity. None of them chose a driving school.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Ten teams, and only one of them is called Flying Pickles. We checked.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Call the Ball is run by a father and driven by his son. Family businesses are known for calm, measured discussion.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Three of tonight's drivers are named Canedy. We will be using first names, for everyone's sake.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Two drivers are named Evan. One of them is Evan. The other is Sholly. This is simpler than it sounds.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Quiet spell. Even the AI drivers seem to be saving themselves.
cards.speaker: ANALYST

cards.line: Nothing happening at the front, which, for the drivers at the front, is the dream.
cards.speaker: ANALYST
